F1.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Feeding Practices in Horses and Other Equids
F1.evidence_text: Beet pulp, a by-product of the sugar beet industry, is added to horse rations as a source of both calories and fiber.

F2.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Feeding Practices in Horses and Other Equids
F2.evidence_text: Beet pulp (shreds or pellets) should be soaked in water before feeding to horses.
F2.statement: Rübenschnitzel sollten vor der Fütterung eingeweicht werden.

F3.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Disorders of the Esophagus
F3.evidence_text: Obstruction is most common when a horse quickly eats dried grain, beet pulp, or hay.
F3.statement: Trockenes Futter einschließlich Rübenschnitzeln kann beim hastigen Fressen Schlundverstopfungen auslösen.

F4.source_title: MSD Veterinary Manual – Disorders of the Esophagus
F4.evidence_text: The main complication of choke is aspiration pneumonia caused by inhalation of food.
